name: Cobalt underglaze painting
summary: Cobalt oxide is painted on the raw or bisque body. A clear glaze covers it, and one firing turns the paint a deep blue.
how: Grind cobalt ore and mix it with water.
Paint the design on the dry body with a brush.
Dip the piece in a clear glaze.

origin.note: Jingdezhen potters make blue-and-white porcelain with imported cobalt.

adoptions.via: Jingdezhen kilns paint porcelain with cobalt for the Yuan court and the export trade.
Iznik potters copy Chinese blue-and-white and paint cobalt on a white stonepaste body.
Jingdezhen potters paint panelled dishes in cobalt blue for export to Portugal and, later, the Dutch Republic.
